text:
sara-sales: Heads up — customer Acme Health wants scope/acceptance criteria confirmed before EOW. They care about latency <= 250ms P95, embedding accuracy on our eval set > 0.85, and SOC2-like logging. Also they added a new requirement for HSM integration. Can PS/Eng confirm feasibility? @ben-ps @kai-ml-eng @marta-secg

ben-ps: Ack. Can we get exact prompts & eval dataset? Also need to confirm model variant — they asked for 13B quantized endpoint initially. :thinking_face:

kai-ml-eng: 13B quantized should hit ~150-200ms P95 on ded. capacity w/ batching disabled for interactive flows. HSM is new — we can support KMS but HSM on-prem will take 2-3w. Need SOW. I'll draft perf test plan.

marta-secg: For security, SOC2-like logging ok; HSM => private deployment req. We need ATO checklist items: key rotation, audit trails, network segmentation. Also need to run their vendor security questionnaire.

sara-sales: They're OK with private deployment if needed but prefer hosted. Budget sensitivity — added cost for Dedicated/Private. Can we propose a compromise: hosted with customer-managed KMS (bring your own key)?

ben-ps: That's workable. BYOK + VPC peering might satisfy them with lower cost. Ask legal about KMS acceptance. I'll update the POC proposal.

kai-ml-eng: For acceptance tests, propose: 1) latency P95 <= 250ms over 1k requests w/ similar token distribution 2) embeddings triplet recall >= 0.85 on customer eval set 3) no PII leakage on 100 sample prompts (we'll run static redaction tests). I'll attach eval script.

ben-ps: Attached eval script snippet: ```bash
python run_eval.py --model redwood-13b-quant --batch 1 --dataset acme_eval.jsonl
```

marta-secg: Also want to see data flow diagram. Customer asked about logs retention — we recommend 90 days by default for POC.

sara-sales: Timeline: kickoff Mon (3 business days), 2 week POC, 1 week buffer for security/questions. Is that realistic?

kai-ml-eng: Tight but ok if we get dataset + sample prompts tomorrow. Otherwise slip to 3w.

ben-ps: Flag: customer requested embedding normalization specifics (L2 vs cosine). We should match their current production system (cosine).

sara-sales: I'll request dataset + any compliance connectors today. Also ask them to sign updated SOW for HSM scope if they push that.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: infra/poc/redwood-13b-quant - started at 1767804620, ETA 12m

kai-ml-eng: Quick note — for the POC we'll run KV cache disabled to match latency profile of cold starts. That needs to be explicit in acceptance.

ben-ps: Adding acceptance item: 'behavioral parity' — no hallucination > 5% on standard prompts.

sara-sales: Great. Can someone send a single-line summary I can forward to customer?

ben-ps: Summary: 'POC: hosted BYOK (unless HSM required) using redwood-13b-quant; acceptance = P95 latency <=250ms, embedding recall >=0.85 (cosine), no PII leakage on 100 samples, behavioral parity <5% hallucination; timeline 2w+1w buffer.'

marta-secg: + action: I'll send vendor questionnaire link and initial security gap list.

sara-sales: Perfect. I'll cc customer and schedule kickoff. :rocket:
